# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the example or documentation change and why it helps users.

## Validation

List offline checks and results, or explain why a check was skipped.

## Safety and licensing

- [ ] Inputs and capabilities are documented; no private or operational data is included
- [ ] Every commit is DCO signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under Apache-2.0
